newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela political party opposes CVG sale.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela political party opposes CVG sale.

text.p: Venezuelan left-leaning opposition party, Radical Cause, formally asked Monday for the pending sale of Corporacion Venezolana de Guayana's (CVG) iron and aluminum firms to be delayed.

Radical Cause spokesman Aristobulo Isturiz said the privatizations, which are expected to raise around $3 billion, should be put off "until Congress has had time to realize a proper study of the process."

Union based Radical Cause, which counts on a total 49 deputies out of 207 seats in Congress's lower chamber, said its objection to the sale was based on a recent report by Congress's Economic Commission.

The Commission criticized the proposed sale, seen by analysts as a key signal of Venezuela's willingness to reform, for failing to detail the cost of the CVG's environmental liabilities, the impact of the sale on the wider Venezuelan economy and workers' treatment after the sale.
